descriptions.preferred: This interesting cultivar was a chance seedling which David Sabo of Charlotte, North Carolina, grew and liked. He sent scion material to Del Loucks of Del's Japanese Maple Nursery, Eugene, Oregon, who propagated and named it. It is a much deeper green than the normal green dissectums, has lacy foliage, and is a fast grower with very pendulous branches. The foliage is yellow green when it first appears in the spring, darkening by midsummer, and then unexpectedly turning a bright burgundy red in the fall. The fiveor seven-lobed medium-sized leaves are 7-8 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, deeply dissected to the leaf base where the lobes narrow to the width of the midrib, less than 1 mm. The lobes and sublobes are well spread outward. The slender but stiff green petioles are 3-4 cm long. 'Emerald Lace' is a vigorous dissectum and forms an irregular semi-upright but spreading bush with long, pendulous branches. It reaches a height and spread of about 2 m in 10 years. This cultivar would make a pleasant contrast with other dissectums with its darker green foliage and different growth habit.

rhs.description: A vigorous, mound-forming, deciduous shrub with arched branches that produce bright green feathery leaves turning to red hues in the autumn. Small red to purple flowers appear in the spring followed in summer by red-winged fruit.

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Rock Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个有趣的品种是一株偶然获得的实生苗，由北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的 David Sabo 栽培并看中。 他将接穗材料寄给俄勒冈州尤金 Del's Japanese Maple Nursery 的 Del Loucks，后者将其繁殖并命名。 它比常见的绿色羽裂类叶色深得多，叶形细致，生长迅速，枝条强烈下垂。 春季初展叶时为黄绿色，至仲夏颜色加深，秋季则出人意料地转为鲜亮的酒红色。 中等大小叶片通常 5 或 7 裂，长 7–8 厘米、宽 8–9 厘米，深裂直达叶基，裂片在基部收窄至接近主脉宽度，不足 1 毫米。 裂片及次级裂片向外舒展良好。 绿色叶柄细长但坚挺，长 3–4 厘米。 ‘Emerald Lace’ 是一个生长强健的羽裂型品种，形成不规则、半直立而开展的灌木，具细长下垂枝。 10 年生时高和冠幅约 2 米。 由于其较深的绿色叶色和不同的树形，它与其他羽裂类品种搭配时能形成宜人的对比。 ‘Bloodgood’ 是可靠的经典标准，所有较新的红叶直立掌叶型品种通常都以其作为比较基准。 ‘Emperor I’ 在叶色保持性和生长速度上甚至超过 ‘Bloodgood’，并且还有一个额外优点，即其展叶时间晚约两周，从而降低晚春霜冻和寒冷干风造成损伤的风险。 它在半阴环境中也能较好保持叶色，因此适应性更强。 叶片为深紫红色，整个生长季都能保持，直至秋季转为美丽的深绯红色。 由于其叶片质地比 ‘Bloodgood’ 更薄，因此透光性更强，在阳光下有通透发亮的效果。 大型叶片通常 5 或 7 裂，长 9–10 厘米、宽 10–13 厘米，裂达叶基的三分之二至四分之三。 每个裂片呈卵形，先端细长尖锐，中部最宽处约 1. 5–2 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至约 1 厘米。 叶缘具许多细小锯齿。 深红色叶柄强健，长 3–5 厘米。 ‘Emperor I’ 耐寒且生长强健，形成直立、宽冠的小乔木。 ‘Red Emperor’ 同样出自 Red Maple Nursery，特征与上述描述相符，可能与其为同一品种。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长旺健、呈土丘状的落叶灌木，枝条拱垂，着生鲜绿色羽毛状叶片，秋季转为红色调。 春季开小型红至紫色花，夏季结红色翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于建筑感庭园、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、低维护花园、岩石园，以及庭院/容器栽培。
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Emerald Lace' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: ACER PALMATUM DISSECTUM 'EMERALD LACE' RED WEEPING GREEN EMERALD LACE JAPANESE MAPLE Zones 5-9 'Emerald Lace' has an extremely fine dissected leaf that makes it stand out among weeping lace leaf types. The overall habit is mounding and spreading, often making this tree have a unique shape that gets wider than tall. We expect 'Emerald Lace' to get 3-4 ft in height by 6-8 ft in width in 15 years. Fall color on 'Emerald Lace' is a bright red to deep maroon. 'Emerald Lace' is extremely heat tolerant, cold tolerant and a good vigorous grower. 'Emerald Lace' was found by David Sabo near Charlotte, NC, and introduced into the nursery trade by our friend and nursery legend, the late Del Loucks.
